technical-summary: pin-bump/repin of an engine whose release line follows the upstream version (radiance) no longer requires a version tag: recipes.version_of_ref takes the version a tag names, or, for an untagged commit, the version upstream declares there (project(<name> VERSION x.y.z) in its top-level CMakeLists.txt), and refuses when neither exists. Used by pin-bump's declare phase and the repin CLI.
user-summary-candidate: Radiance can be bumped to an untagged upstream commit; its release version comes from the version upstream declares at that commit.
